_note: S12 two-way combat: GAME values for flight/weapons/damage.js, ew.js and ai-weapons.js. Every number is invented for gameplay and readability; none is taken from, or tuned against, any real weapon, sensor or countermeasure. Units: s, m, m/s, deg, kg/s, fractions 0..1.

zoneSplit._: body m (x right, y up, z aft of the CG): engine = z > engineZ; controls = |x| > wingX or z > tailZ; else fuel (engine also needs |x| < wingX, |y| < 0.9)

f16._boxes: ESTIMATE from the public F-16 size (length 15.0 m, span 9.45 m with missiles, height 5.1 m); body axes x right, y up, z aft of the CG

cms._gap: s between two releases of the key's program (one flare + one chaff)
cms._decoy: chance that ONE release makes ONE incoming game missile of that class lose its target (rolled per missile per release; class short = IR-like, long = radar-like)

rwr._mwsRange: game missile warning for the short class (IR missiles give no RWR launch cue): MISSILE when one is this close

ai._gun: rate = rounds/s (game, fewer than a real gun for frame cost); cone = deg off the bandit's nose to its lead point; aspect = max deg between the F-16's tail and the line to the bandit (rear hemisphere + a bit)
ai._firstShot: s after a bandit enters MERGE before it may shoot, + a random 0..firstShotJitter s per merge (a pair does not fire together)
